verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official CLI (vastai) documented in depth, covering GPU search, instance lifecycle, templates, volumes, serverless endpoints, scoped API keys, and even an agent skill for AI coding assistants to drive it, plus a GitHub repo confirming its existence and usage examples. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community verification specifically of the CLI's UX/reliability (community evidence covers the platform generally, not CLI specifics).
